app.name: Paper Boat
library.emptyBody: Open Settings and tap "Update Books" to download stories from the server.
library.shelfBody: Story, audio and practice all live on the device.
book.flowNote: Each chapter moves listen → words → quiz → retell. Finished chapters stay open for another read.
s6.title: You told the story.
s6.body: You listened and read the story, met {words} new words, and told it back in your own words.
s6.bodyTail: No score — just one complete pass.
s5.title: Tell the story
s5.prompt: Tell the story you just read in your own words.
s5.permBody: Retell practice needs a recording. Your voice is recognised on this device only and never uploaded.
s5.tooShort: Too short — hold a little longer.
s5.asrNote: Speech recognition is not connected yet — below are the key points.
vocab.heading: Met in the story
vocab.flip: Tap the card to see the meaning
vocab.helper: Look through every new word to continue
s4.tip: You can try again even if you miss. The answer is never shown — look back at the story.
s4.unlockBody: You understood this chapter. Tell it in your own words — no score, no ranking.
s2.tapHint: Tap any sentence to start listening from there
s2.helper: Read to the end to continue
retell.feedback.fluency: Speak a little more slowly and pause between ideas.
retell.feedback.noSpeech: I did not hear anything. Try again closer to the microphone.
err.content: Could not load the book. Please try again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.offlineBody: Story, audio and speech recognition all live on the device. A full chapter works in airplane mode.
settings.updateBooksSub: Check for and download book updates from server
settings.reduceMotionSub: Turns off celebration, flips and page transitions
settings.uiLocaleSheetBody: Changes buttons, navigation and hints. The story itself stays in English.
settings.uiLocaleSheetCaption: Word meanings have their own setting below.
settings.glossLocaleSheetBody: Sets the language of definitions on vocabulary cards, independent of the interface.
settings.glossLocaleSheetCaption: Story sentences always stay in English.
settings.licenseSheetBody:
Illustrations and icons: original SVG work, © 2026 StoryBook · Paper Boat.
Fonts: system fonts (Iowan Old Style / Palatino / Source Han Serif) under their system licences; not bundled.
Audio: placeholder sample. Speech recognition runs on-device; model licences must be reviewed before release.
settings.licenseSheetCaption: Fonts and icons ship under their own licences. Story attribution comes from the content pack.
settings.privacySheetBody:
The microphone is active only while you hold the record button. Speech is transcribed on-device; audio and text never leave it.
The app runs fully offline and collects no accounts, location or usage data.
settings.privacySheetCaption: No network permission. No cloud sync.
library.deleteBody: The book and its downloaded audio are removed from this device. You can download it again anytime.
settings.redownloadHint: Downloading again replaces the local copy
